## Stories That Stay With You Long After the Last Page


These aren't just books — they're worlds carefully built to be lived in. From epic adventure and magical discovery to found family and heart-stopping suspense, each series in the Dream Quest collection is crafted as a collectible reading experience readers return to again and again.


- ### Epic YA Fantasy Worlds Richly imagined realms where magic feels earned, stakes feel real, and every quest reshapes the characters who undertake it.

- ### Suspense & Emotional Resonance Stories that hold tension alongside tenderness — where the emotional journey matters as much as the plot that drives it forward.

- ### Found Family at the Heart Unforgettable ensemble casts bound by loyalty, loss, and love — the kind of characters readers name as lifelong favourites.

## Why Readers Return to Dream Quest


Discover stories built for wonder, connection, and conversation. This is a trusted place to explore the author's world, learn about each book, and reach out directly — from discovery to your next great read.













### Immersive Fantasy Escapes


Step into richly imagined worlds where every page deepens the journey. Dream Quest books are crafted for readers who crave stories that linger long after the final chapter — adventures that transport, challenge, and inspire.











### Meaningful Author Connection


Go beyond the page and connect directly with the author. Learn the inspiration behind each story, follow the creative process, and reach out personally. This site is your direct line — no intermediaries, no distance.











### Book-Club-Ready Stories


Each book is written with depth that sparks conversation. Themes of identity, courage, and belonging give reading groups rich material to explore together — making Dream Quest titles a natural fit for kindle direct publishing platforms and independent reading circles alike.

The Reading Experience

## Where Stories Become Worlds


Dream Quest Media Books invites you into layered fantasy worlds built for readers who crave emotional depth, collectible beauty, and a community that shares your love of the extraordinary. Every title is crafted to be discovered, savoured, and treasured.













### Layered Fantasy Worlds


Each book unfolds a richly constructed universe — with its own lore, geography, and mythology — inviting readers to lose themselves completely in stories that reward curiosity and reward re-reading.










### Emotionally Engaging Journeys


Beyond plot and world-building, these stories are driven by characters whose struggles and triumphs feel genuinely human — narratives that stay with you long after the final page, shaping how you see the world.










### Collectible Editions & Community


From beautifully produced collectible editions available through kindle direct publishing and beyond, to a welcoming reader community — Dream Quest Media Books is more than a bookshelf. It's a shared adventure for kindred spirits.








Every page, a new world to inhabit.


















## The Reading Experience


Cover details, flat lays, and reading ambience — curated for book clubs, social sharing, and the joy of a beautifully printed page.





All Products













Featured

Every page is an invitation — crafted with care from manuscript to finished cover. These images capture what it feels like to hold a Dream Quest Media book in your hands.

Presentation-ready for gifting, book clubs, or your own curated shelf — a complete literary experience.

























## For Book Clubs & Reading Communities


Everything you need to bring these stories into your reading group, online community, or personal reflection practice — thoughtfully curated for deeper engagement.













### Discussion Guide Themes


Each book in the Dream Quest Media catalog is built around layered themes — identity, resilience, faith, and belonging — that open naturally into rich group conversation. Look for the central tension between the protagonist's inner world and outer circumstances, and consider how the author's voice guides readers through moral complexity without prescribing easy answers.


- Character motivation and transformation arcs

- Cultural and historical context woven into the narrative

- The role of community versus solitude in the story

- Moments of ambiguity that invite multiple readings












### Reader Note Prompts


Annotating as you read transforms a book from a passive experience into a personal dialogue. These prompts are designed to help you slow down and notice what the text is doing beneath the surface — ideal for solo reading journals or group preparation before a meeting.


- Which sentence made you pause — and why?

- Note a moment where the author withholds information. What effect does that create?

- Where do you see your own experience reflected in the story?

- What question would you ask the author if you could?

- Identify a passage worth reading aloud to your group.












### Online Community Features


Dream Quest Media Books travels well in digital reading spaces. Whether you're hosting a virtual book club, organizing a read-along on social media, or featuring a title in your newsletter, here are ideas for bringing these stories to your online audience in meaningful ways.


- Share a favourite passage with the hashtag for your reading group

- Post a photo of your reading setup alongside the book cover

- Host a chapter-by-chapter discussion thread or Discord channel

- Invite members to share their reader notes publicly or in private

- Feature the book in your Goodreads shelf or reading blog review












### Featuring the Books


Authors like Joseph Christ, whose work appears across kindle direct publishing platforms and independent booksellers, benefit enormously from community-led visibility. If you'd like to feature a Dream Quest Media title in your reading space, consider these approaches for authentic, meaningful promotion.


- Write a personal review on Amazon, Goodreads, or Barnes & Noble

- Recommend the book in reading community newsletters or forums

- Tag the author when sharing your thoughts on social media

- Suggest the title for your local library's community reads program












### Book Club Selection Tips


Choosing the right book for your group is as much about timing and mood as it is about genre. These titles work well for groups that appreciate literary depth alongside accessible storytelling — a balance that makes for lively, inclusive discussion without requiring academic background.


- Ideal group size: 4–12 readers for balanced conversation

- Recommended reading pace: 2–3 chapters per week

- Works well for mixed-genre and cross-cultural reading groups

- Pairs naturally with memoir, historical fiction, and spiritual nonfiction












### Connect with the Author


Book clubs and reading communities are warmly encouraged to reach out directly. Whether you'd like to invite the author for a virtual Q&A, request a personalised message for your group, or simply share your reading experience, the Dream Quest Media team is glad to hear from engaged readers. This kind of direct connection between author and audience is at the heart of what independent publishing makes possible.


- Virtual author appearances for book clubs (subject to availability)

- Personalised reading group acknowledgements on request

- Share your group photos and reviews via the contact page
























## Stories Written for You


Dream Quest Media Books crafts worlds built to be lived in — layered with mythology, heart, and consequence. Whether you're a lifelong lover of epic fantasy, a young adult reader hungry for emotionally resonant adventure, or a book club searching for your next great conversation, these stories meet you exactly where you are. Every page is an invitation to go deeper, feel more, and discover something true about the human experience through the power of imaginative fiction.


From kindle book publishing to independent booksellers, these stories are available wherever you love to read — crafted with the same care a literary press brings to every title it champions.











### Fantasy Enthusiasts


For readers who crave immersive worldbuilding, rich mythology, and stories that feel as expansive as they do intimate. If you've ever lost yourself inside a map at the front of a novel, these books were written with you in mind. Expect intricate magic systems, morally layered characters, and landscapes that breathe.












### Young Adult Readers


Stories that take your emotions seriously — coming-of-age arcs set against extraordinary backdrops, where identity, courage, and belonging are tested at every turn. These are adventures that don't talk down to you, with protagonists who earn their growth through genuine struggle and real stakes.












### Book Clubs


Thematically rich narratives that generate genuine conversation long after the last page. Questions of power, sacrifice, memory, and justice are woven into every arc — giving your group the kind of layered material that sustains a full evening of engaged, spirited discussion. A reading guide is available upon request.










Curated stories. Thoughtful voices. Independent publishing at its finest — where every page is a new quest.

About the Author


# Crafting Worlds,One Story at a Time


Joseph Christ is the creative force behind Dream Quest Media Books — an independent author and publisher dedicated to bringing vivid fantasy worlds directly to readers who crave immersive storytelling. With a passion for building richly layered narratives, Joseph has spent years developing stories that blend mythic adventure with deeply human themes, characters whose journeys linger long after the final page.


Dream Quest Media Books was born from a belief that great fiction deserves a direct path from the creator to the reader. By publishing independently through platforms including Kindle Direct Publishing and Amazon Kindle self publishing, Joseph retains full creative control while building a genuine connection with his audience — no intermediaries, no compromises, just authentic storytelling at its best.






### The Dream Quest Mission


Every book published under the Dream Quest Media Books imprint is a commitment to readers who deserve stories that challenge, inspire, and transport. The mission is simple: write with intention, publish with integrity, and connect with the people who love fantasy as deeply as the author does.

Connect with Joseph

















Joseph Christ
Author & Publisher, Dream Quest Media Books
























## A Writer's Journey


From a single spark of inspiration to a growing body of work — the story behind Dream Quest Media Books.













### Early Inspiration


The Spark


Every story begins with a question that refuses to stay quiet. Long before the first manuscript took shape, a deep fascination with storytelling, myth, and the human capacity for wonder set the foundation for what would become a lifelong pursuit. Reading widely — from classic literature to self-published voices on kindle direct publishing platforms — revealed that the most powerful stories are those told with honesty and intention.










### First Manuscript


The Work Begins


The first full manuscript was a reckoning — months of drafts, revisions, and the quiet discipline of returning to the page each day. Writing the first book meant learning not just the craft of storytelling but the architecture of a complete narrative: how to build tension, develop character, and deliver an ending that earns its emotional weight. That first completed draft became the proof of concept for everything that followed.










### Publishing Vision


Dream Quest Media Books


Founding Dream Quest Media Books was a deliberate choice to take ownership of the creative process from manuscript to reader. Drawing on the possibilities opened by kindle book publishing and direct distribution, the vision was to build an independent press that could move at the speed of the story — without compromise. Every design decision, every cover, every launch reflects an author who believes deeply in the work.










### Reader Engagement


Now & Forward


Today the focus is on building a direct relationship with readers — the people who pick up a book because a title or a premise caught their attention and decided to give their time to the story. Through this site, through community, and through continued writing, the goal is simple: to put the right books in front of the right readers, and to keep earning that trust one page at a time.
























Creative Philosophy


## The Art of Storytelling


Every book begins with a question worth asking — and a reader worth answering it for. These are the principles that guide every word written under Dream Quest Media Books.












### Emotional Resonance


Stories that endure are not built on plot alone — they are built on feeling. Each narrative is crafted to move readers, to surface truths they already carry within them, and to leave an impression long after the final page. In the tradition of kindle book publishing at its most intentional, emotion is never incidental — it is the architecture.










### Immersive World-Building


A great book is a place readers inhabit, not merely visit. Through deliberate detail, layered atmosphere, and consistent internal logic, each story creates a world with its own gravity. Readers should feel the texture of the setting, the weight of the stakes, and the inevitability of the journey — as if they have always belonged inside these pages.










### Meaningful Reader Relationships


Publishing is not a transaction — it is a conversation that begins on the page and continues beyond it. Dream Quest Media Books is built on the belief that readers deserve direct access to the author's voice, vision, and creative journey. Every book is an invitation to a relationship that grows with each new story shared.
























“
Fantasy does not escape the world — it illuminates it. When you close the last page of a book and sit in silence for a moment, not quite ready to return, that is the journey I am chasing with every word I write. I want readers to feel that they have lived somewhere else, loved someone impossible, and returned home quietly changed.
”



— Joseph Christ, Author & Publisher


From the first chapter to the final line, every book published under Dream Quest Media Books is built on a single belief: that imaginative storytelling is not a luxury — it is how we remember what it means to be human. Whether you discover our titles through kindle direct publishing or your local shelf, the journey begins the moment you open the cover.











Curated stories. Thoughtful voices. Independent publishing at its finest — where every page is a new quest.

# We'd Love to Hear From You


Whether you're a reader with a question, a book club looking for your next great read, or an event organizer interested in a visit — this is the place to start. Reach out and we'll get back to you personally.












## What You Can Ask About


We welcome all kinds of messages — there's no wrong reason to write. Here are a few things readers commonly reach out about:


- — General reader messages & feedback

- — Book club reading guides & group outreach

- — Signed copy & personalized book requests

- — Speaking engagements & event appearances

- — Media, press & publishing inquiries











## What to Expect in Return


Every message is read personally. Here's what you can count on when you reach out to Dream Quest Media Books:


- — A thoughtful, personal reply — not a form response

- — Response within 2–4 business days

- — Honest answers about books, availability & events

- — Signed copy arrangements handled with care

- — Media & press inquiries given prompt attention

## Frequently Asked Questions


Everything you need to know about connecting with the author, obtaining signed editions, and staying part of the Dream Quest community.





All Products
















### How quickly do you respond to messages?


I aim to respond to all reader messages within 2–3 business days. During busy periods — such as around new releases or book events — it may take a little longer, but every message is read and valued.









### Can I request a signed edition?


Yes! Signed copies are available on a limited basis. Reach out through the contact form with your request and preferred title. I'll confirm availability and walk you through the ordering process directly.









### Are your books available on Kindle Direct Publishing?


My titles are available through multiple channels including Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) and select retailers. You can purchase digital and print editions directly from this site or through your preferred platform.









### Do you participate in book club discussions?


Absolutely — book club conversations are one of my favourite ways to connect with readers. I'm available for virtual Q&A sessions and group discussions. Send me a message with your club's details and preferred dates to get started.









### How can I stay connected and hear about new releases?


The best way to stay in the loop is to join my reader list via the newsletter sign-up on this site. You'll be the first to hear about new titles, events, and exclusive content — no spam, just stories.









### Can I reach out for media or interview requests?


Yes — I welcome media inquiries, podcast invitations, and interview requests. Please use the contact form and include relevant details about your publication or platform. I'll respond as promptly as possible.









### Do you offer bulk or wholesale orders?


Bulk orders for schools, libraries, or community groups can be arranged. Get in touch through the contact form with your quantity and purpose, and I'll be happy to discuss options and pricing tailored to your needs.









### Where can I leave a review or share feedback?


Reader reviews mean the world to independent authors. You're welcome to leave a review on Amazon, Barnes & Noble, or Goodreads — or simply drop me a personal note here. Honest feedback helps more readers discover the work.









### Is there a way to follow along on social media?


Yes — you can find Dream Quest Media Books on social platforms where I share writing updates, reading recommendations, and behind-the-scenes glimpses of the creative process. Links are in the footer of every page.

# Return Policy


Last Updated: 5/24/2026



At Dream Quest Media Books, we want you to be satisfied with your purchase. This policy outlines your rights for returns and refunds.


## 1. Return Window


You may return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.


- Items must be unused and in original condition

- Items must be in original packaging

- Receipt or proof of purchase required




## 2. Non-Returnable Items


- Perishable goods

- Custom or personalized items

- Digital products and opened software

- Personal hygiene products that have been opened




## 3. Damaged or Defective Items


If you receive a damaged or defective item, contact us within 48 hours for a full refund including shipping costs.


## 4. Contact Us



For returns or questions:


Email: [business_email]


Phone: [business_phone]


Address: [business_address]

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  5/24/2026



Dream Quest Media Books ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: Dream Quest Media Books

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  May 24, 2026



Dream Quest Media Books is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Dream Quest Media Books

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.

# Terms of Use



Last updated:  May 24, 2026



Use of this site constitutes agreement to the terms outlined below. Please read carefully before use.



## 1. Definitions


- "Company" - Dream Quest Media Books

- "User" - Anyone who browses or uses the site

- "Services" - Publishing provided through the site




## 2. Description of Services


Dream Quest Media Books provides Publishing through the site. The services are subject to the terms detailed in this document and may change from time to time.


## 3. Terms of Use


Use of the site is conditional on compliance with the following terms:


- Use of the site for lawful purposes only

- No interference with site operations or other users

- No uploading of offensive, illegal, or harmful content

- Respect for copyright and intellectual property rights

- No actions that may compromise site security




## 4. User Obligations


- Providing accurate and truthful information during registration or ordering

- Maintaining confidentiality of account access details

- Immediate notification of any unauthorized account use

- Updating personal information as needed




## 5. Payment and Refund Policy


If services include payment:


- Payments are processed through secure and encrypted systems

- Prices include applicable taxes as required by law

- Right to cancel will be in accordance with consumer protection laws

- Refunds will be processed within 14 business days of cancellation approval




## 6. Limitation of Liability


Services are provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. The Company will not be liable for indirect, consequential, or special damages arising from use of the site, except where required by law.


## 7. Copyright and Intellectual Property


All content on the site, including text, images, design, and code, is protected by copyright owned by Dream Quest Media Books. Reproduction, distribution, or commercial use of content is prohibited without written permission.


## 8. Privacy


Collection and use of personal information is subject to our Privacy Policy. Use of the site constitutes agreement to the Privacy Policy as detailed separately.


## 9. Changes to Terms of Use


The Company may change these terms of use at any time. Material changes will be posted on the site with 30 days advance notice. Continued use after changes constitutes agreement to the new terms.


## 10. Service Termination


The Company may suspend or limit service at any time, including in cases of terms of use violations. In case of service termination, relevant provisions will remain in effect.


## 11. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution


These terms of use are governed by applicable laws. Any disputes will be resolved in accordance with local jurisdiction, with preference given to arbitration or mediation where possible.


## 12. General Provisions


- If any portion of the terms is found invalid, remaining terms will remain in effect

- Non-enforcement of a right will not be considered a waiver

- These terms of use constitute the entire agreement between the parties





## 13. Contact Information


For questions or clarifications regarding the terms of use:


- Company: Dream Quest Media Books

- Email: [business_email]
